editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a boring job and your mean boss suddenly dies right in front of you. Instead of calling the police, you and your coworker decide to keep the body and pretend he is still alive so you can enjoy his fancy beach house and money. That is exactly the wild setup here. You get to follow two lazy employees who spend their whole vacation putting sunglasses on a dead guy and moving his arms to trick everyone. It is a total blast that does not take itself seriously, making it the perfect choice for a lazy Friday night when you just want to laugh at something completely ridiculous.

The acting is great because the leads play off each other so well, and the physical comedy of moving a limp body is honestly hilarious. While the plot is simple and not very deep, the pacing keeps things moving fast so you never get bored. If you love goofy comedies from the eighties, you have to see this. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you want those crisp colors, or you could just rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the hitman finally catches up to the group. In a chaotic final scramble, the dead boss actually ends up saving the day by accidentally knocking out the bad guy. The police arrive and the truth comes out, but the two main characters manage to avoid jail time. They end up getting away with their little scheme and find a way to keep living the high life without their boss breathing down their necks.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and slapstick humor.
